resolution.note: scripts/claude/capture-fixture.ts with test; existing fixtures unchanged by it.

title: Provide a tracked redacting capture tool for transcript fixtures
body:
Outcome: KRN-12 verbatim transcript fixtures are produced by a tracked script that elides message content and redacts cwd, instead of hand-derived lines. Observed 2026-11-01: auto mode denied copying a transcript line into test/claude/fixtures ("Sensitive-Source Provenance"), so the gauge baseline fixture was derived from an older capture by changing counters.
Proof: the script turns a transcript line into a fixture line with content [] and cwd ".", with a test; existing fixtures reproduce from it.
